(001)

Mountain Cleanup 2026 — Volunteer Sign-Up

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #001 — Sign Up. Design a sign-up page, modal, form or flow.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A friendly, accessible volunteer sign-up for a community mountain cleanup. A "Join the Adventure" landing panel sets the tone, the phone screen shows the event card (Mountain Cleanup 2026 · Islamabad · October 18, 2026 · 120 volunteers) above a simple registration form — full name, email, phone, event and date pickers and a "Join the Event" button — and a "You're All Set!" confirmation screen closes the flow, all in an encouraging outdoorsy green palette.

  • Sign-up form
  • Event registration
  • Illustration
  • Accessibility

(002)

Credit Card Checkout

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #002 — Credit Card Checkout. Design a credit card checkout form or page.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A clean, modern checkout built to make online payments feel simple and secure. A three-step progress bar (Shipping → Payment → Confirmation) leads into the card number, expiry date, CVV and name on card, a billing address that can match the shipping address, a "save card" option and a clear "Pay Now" button; the order summary panel shows the item, subtotal, shipping, tax and total with a "100% Secure Checkout" badge and accepted payment methods.

(003)

Synapse — SaaS Project Management Landing Page

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #003 — Landing Page. Design a landing page for a product or service.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A conversion-focused landing page for Synapse, a fictional SaaS project-management platform. A high-contrast hero states the value proposition with two CTAs ("Get Started Free" and "Watch Demo"), monochrome partner logos add social proof, and a feature grid presents progress visualisation, automated reporting and integrations — all in a crisp teal and blue palette with approachable vector illustrations.

(004)

Home Loan Calculator

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #004 — Calculator. Design a calculator (standard, scientific or for a specific purpose).

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A detailed, calculation-driven mortgage affordability calculator on a phone. Inputs for home price (with a slider), down payment, loan term and interest rate give instant results: the estimated monthly payment as a donut chart split into principal & interest, taxes and insurance, a principal-vs-interest-over-time bar chart, and a projected amortisation timeline. The dark theme keeps the key numbers prominent.

(006)

User Profile Interface

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #006 — User Profile. Design a user profile page or screen.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A clean, visual-first profile for digital artists and illustrators. A cover banner and ringed avatar sit above the name, handle, location and bio; followers, following and project counts lead into a "Featured Work" grid of the artist's pieces with likes and comments; a right column lists art tools, software and interests, with a bottom tab bar for navigation.

(007)

Settings & Preferences Dashboard

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #007 — Settings. Design a settings or preferences screen.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

An intuitive, multi-column settings dashboard for Creaive, her fictional digital creator platform. The profile card and page title sit on a soft blurred header, and four columns group the preferences — Account & Security, Creaive Preferences (privacy, post visibility, mentions, tagging), Application Settings (theme, language, upload quality) and Notifications with toggles — plus Help & Community links and a bottom tab bar.

(008)

404 Page — "This Masterpiece is Missing"

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #008 — 404 Page. Design a 404 "page not found" screen.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

A brand-aligned, playful 404 page for Creaive that turns a dead end into a moment of delight: a brush-stroke "404", the line "Error: This Masterpiece is Missing", an illustrated artist puzzling over a glitching canvas, "Go to Feed" and "Return to Profile" buttons, and "find your lost muse" links to search, explore or start a new creation.

(009)

Tablet Music Player & Audio Experience

TAP TO VIEW ↗

(THE CHALLENGE)

Daily UI #009 — Music Player. Design a music player interface.

(WHAT I DESIGNED / OUTCOME)

An immersive, tablet-first music and audio player for Creaive. Large album art and the track title ("Ethereal Echoes") lead the screen, with a gradient progress bar, Prev/Next controls, like, add-to-playlist and share actions, listen counts, and a "Creator Insights" card about the album — all on a teal-to-blue gradient with the Creaive mark and the shared bottom tab bar.
